text:
maria: heads up, staging canary for 2026.03.19 patch is spiking errors in embed-service (eu-west1) — ~6% 500s over the last 8m. tagging oncall. urgent decision: rollback to v2026.03.18 or pin and continue with a staggered ramp? @ops-oncall @release-manager

deploy-bot: Canary health check FAILED for embed-service (eu-west1). 6.2% 500s, latency +40% vs baseline. Canary promotion paused.

ops-oncall: looking now. logs show NPE in kv-cache eviction path triggered by the new quant shim. stack trace points at cache/evict.go:142. Not yet seen in prod regions.

jon: if it's an NPE from the kv eviction we should rollback the quant change. Rollback path is tested and fast. +1 from infra.

dakota: can we hotfix instead? rollback loses perf wins for the week. how risky is the patch?

qa-lead: hotfix needs full acceptance tests and we can't guarantee CI pass in <30m. patch window would push into late hours. rollback is lower risk right now.

release-manager: we have the change window until 23:59. need decision in ~15m. quick vote: react with :thumbsup: to rollback, :thumbsdown: to continue.

samir: +1 rollback. we can pin the change and re-run a smaller canary after a proper patch.

deploy-bot: Rollback command available. To run:```bash
redwood deploy rollback --service embed-service --to v2026.03.18 --region eu-west1
```

maria: executing rollback now. running smoke tests post-rollback and will update release notes with revert details.

ops-oncall: confirmed rollback start (manual trigger by maria). watching logs. ETA ~4m for full roll back and health recovery.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by maria at 2026-03-19T22:10:12Z. Canary paused; subsequent deploys to embed-service in eu-west1 blocked until manual clear.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed. embed-service 500s down to 0.5% in eu-west1; latency back to baseline.

release-manager: thanks — good call. we'll hold the quantization change. maria please add a short entry to the release tracker: cause = kv-cache eviction NPE introduced by quant shim. plan = revert + patch + re-canary tomorrow. postmortem to follow.

maria: added note to release tracker and pinned the revert in the notes. pinging research and eng-ml for root cause analysis.

dakota: I'll prototype a minimal change for the cache eviction guard tomorrow morning. cc @qa-lead for validation plan. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

qa-lead: will prep test permutations for the kv cache edge cases and schedule a targeted canary after fix verification.

release-manager: moving to status CLOSED for this thread. follow-up ticket created: INF-4721 (root cause + patch).

maria: closing the loop — reassigning INF-4721 to dakota and ops-oncall. will share timeline in next standup.
